blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Brain encoding models predict neural responses from audiovisual input, but typically overlook how ongoing brain activity shapes an individual's response. We introduce EEG-World, a recurrent world model that forecasts 10 seconds of EEG band-power dynamics from 6 seconds of preceding EEG and the subsequent audiovisual stimulus. Pretrained on continuous EEG, EEG-World learns shared neural dynamics and adapts to unseen individuals through lightweight subject-specific readouts. Using 2,584 hours of EEG from 78 participants, we show that nonlinear recurrent forecasting surpasses strong history-aware linear baselines at scale. EEG-World achieves a forecasting correlation of 0.261 versus 0.233 for the strongest history-and-video linear model, with a 3.3-second forecasting-horizon advantage. Its learned dynamics transfer to unseen participants, outperforming the linear baseline in 23 of 24 individuals after calibration. While ongoing EEG history accounts for most predictive performance, controlled stimulus analyses reveal an additional video-dependent component. This component also enables evaluation of visual representations, with V-JEPA 2 improving clip-locked prediction by 35% over combined CLIP and DINOv2 features. Our results demonstrate the value of transferable neural dynamics for individual EEG forecasting and highlight the importance of separating state-driven from stimulus-driven predictability.
blocks.zh: 大脑编码模型预测从视听输入中产生的神经响应,但一般忽略了正在进行的大脑活性如何塑造个人的反应. 我们引入了EEG-World(EEG-World),这是一个经常性的世界模型,它从EEG之前的6秒和随后的视听刺激中预测出EEG波段力动态的10秒. EEG-World通过连续的EEG预训,通过轻量级主题特定读取来学习共享神经动力学,并适应于看不见的个人. 我们利用来自78名参与者的2,584小时的脑电图显示,非线性经常性预测在规模上超过了具有强烈历史认识的线性基线。 EEG-World实现最强历史和视频线性模型的预测相关性为0.261比0.233,具有3.3秒的预测-视距优势. 其学习到的动态向看不见的参与者转移,在校准后超过24人中的23人的线性基线。 虽然目前的EEG历史反映了大多数预测性表现,但受控刺激分析揭示了另一个依赖视频的部分. 这一组成部分还使得能够评价视觉表现,V-JEPA 2将剪辑锁入的预测比综合的CLIP和DINov2特性改进了35%。 我们的结果显示了可转移神经动态对单个电子环境学预测的价值,并突出了将国家驱动和刺激驱动的可预测性区分开来的重要性。

blocks.en: Brain recordings during naturalistic video viewing have become an important testbed for vision models: representations that predict neural activity are taken as evidence of alignment with human visual processing [ 49 , 41 , 22 ] . EEG makes such measurements more accessible and offers a temporally resolved view of brain activity. Predicting the neural response evoked by a stimulus, however, is not the same as forecasting how a particular viewer’s brain activity will unfold while watching it. Even for the same video, different viewers can follow different neural trajectories because they start from different brain states ( Fig. 1 ). Forecasting these trajectories therefore requires modeling not only what is on screen but also the brain’s ongoing dynamics.
blocks.zh: 自然主义视频观看过程中的脑录制成为视觉模型的重要试验床:预测神经活性的表现被作为与人类视觉处理一致的证据[49,41,22]. EEG使这种测量方法更容易获得,并提供了暂时解决的大脑活动观点. 但预测刺激引发的神经反应与预测特定观众的大脑活动在观察时会如何展开并不相同。 即使对于同一段视频,不同的观看者也可以遵循不同的神经轨迹,因为它们是从不同的大脑状态(图1)开始的. 因此,预测这些轨迹不仅需要模拟屏幕上的内容,还需要模拟大脑的持续动态。

blocks.en: Conventional stimulus-to-brain encoding models predict neural responses from visual or audiovisual features [ 34 , 26 , 35 , 23 ] . Although effective at characterizing stimulus-related responses, they typically do not condition on an individual’s preceding neural activity. This omission matters particularly for EEG, where ongoing rhythms and temporal persistence make recent activity highly predictive of the next few seconds. As a result, a model can forecast EEG accurately while learning little about the stimulus itself. This raises two questions: can nonlinear models capture neural dynamics beyond what strong history-aware linear models already explain, and can the resulting state-driven predictability be separated from the contribution of the video?
blocks.zh: 常规刺激对大脑编码模型预测视觉或视听特征的神经反应[34、26、35、23]。 虽然能有效地描述与刺激有关的对策,但它们通常并不取决于个人先前的神经活动。 这一疏漏对欧洲教育小组尤为重要,因为目前的节奏和时间持久性使得最近的活动对接下来的几秒钟具有高度的预测性。 因此,一个模型可以准确预测EEG,同时很少了解刺激本身. 这提出了两个问题:非线性模型能否捕捉到超越强历史认知线性模型已经解释的神经动态,以及由此产生的状态驱动的可预测性能否与视频的贡献分开?

blocks.en: We approach this problem through the lens of world models , which predict how a system evolves from its current state under external inputs [ 15 , 16 , 18 ] . In our setting, the brain is the dynamical system, EEG provides partial observations of its state, and the video acts as an exogenous input. We introduce EEG-World, which infers a latent brain state from preceding EEG and rolls it forward under audiovisual conditioning to forecast an individual’s neural activity. A recurrent dynamics core is pretrained on continuous EEG, and lightweight subject-specific readouts adapt the shared dynamics to new individuals. Because neural history alone explains much of the future activity, we compare against strong linear forecasters that receive the same EEG history and video, rather than against stimulus-only encoding models.
blocks.zh: 我们从世界模型的角度来看待这个问题,这些模型预测一个系统如何从外部投入下的现状演变出来[15、16、18]。 在我们的环境下,大脑是动态系统, EEG提供了部分的观测其状态,视频起到外部输入的作用. 我们引入了EEG-World,它从之前的EEG推断出潜在的大脑状态,并将它推向视听条件,以预测一个人的神经活动。 一个经常性的动态核心在连续的EEG上预先训练,轻量级主题特定读取使共享的动态适应新的个体. 因为神经历史本身就解释了未来活动的大部分,我们比较了接收同样的EEG历史和视频的强线性预测器,而不是只使用刺激编码模型.

blocks.en: Learning and evaluating such dynamics requires data that existing EEG resources rarely combine: extensive recordings to learn temporal regularities, the same videos shown to many viewers to separate stimulus-driven from state-driven activity, and enough participants to hold some out for testing transfer. To meet these requirements, we collect VAEEG, a dataset of 2,584 hours of EEG from 78 participants watching naturalistic audiovisual clips. On this dataset, nonlinear recurrent forecasting overtakes strong linear baselines once hundreds of hours are pooled and keeps improving as linear models saturate. Its dynamics transfer to unseen participants, where 33 minutes of calibration match a linear model fitted on ten times more data. Although ongoing EEG dynamics dominate the predictive performance, controlled stimulus analyses reveal an additional video-dependent component whose in-silico tuning matches recorded EEG, enabling more informative comparisons between visual representations and human neural responses.
blocks.zh: 学习和评价这些动态需要数据,而现有的教育、科学和技术资源很少将这些数据结合起来:大量录音学习时间规律,向许多观众展示的同样视频将刺激驱动的活动与国家驱动的活动区分开来,以及足够的参与者将一些内容保留下来进行测试转移。 为满足这些要求,我们从78名观看自然视听片段的参与者那里收集了VAEEG这一2 584小时的EEG数据集. 在这个数据集上,非线性经常性预测在数百小时集合后超过强线性基线,并随着线性模型饱和不断改进. 它的动力学向看不见的参与者转移,在那里33分钟的校准与一个安装在十倍多数据的线性模型匹配. 虽然持续的EEG动态在预测性能中占据主导地位,但受控刺激分析揭示了另一个依赖视频的组件,其内硅调制匹配所记录的EEG,使得视觉表现和人类神经反应之间能够进行更加翔实的比较.

blocks.en: • We introduce EEG-World, a recurrent world model for individual EEG forecasting that combines pretrained neural dynamics, audiovisual conditioning, and lightweight subject-specific adaptation. • We demonstrate that nonlinear recurrent forecasting surpasses strong history-aware linear baselines at scale, with learned dynamics transferring to unseen participants, using 2,584 hours of naturalistic EEG from 78 participants. • We establish history-aware baselines and persistence-controlled evaluations that distinguish neural-state predictability from stimulus-driven responses, enabling more targeted comparisons of visual representations with the brain.

blocks.en:
World models learn how an environment evolves under an agent’s actions [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 33 , 4 ] ; in their usual settings the observation is
rich and the actions strongly drive what comes next. For the brain, latent dynamical models infer neural states from
spiking activity [ 38 , 50 ] , and NeuroWorld [ 9 ] rolls out fMRI with the
stimulus as the action, starting from a single observed volume. Neither transfers directly to EEG. First, the scalp
signal is a noisy mixture driven mostly by ongoing activity, so the state must be inferred from seconds of history,
not one snapshot, and the video is a weak input to strong internal dynamics. Second, the phase of ongoing
oscillations is unpredictable seconds ahead, so reconstructing the raw signal, as pixel world models reconstruct
frames, is ill-posed; band power is predictable. Third, channel and band scales differ between subjects, so one
readout cannot serve all, while a new subject offers only minutes of data. Fourth, a slow, persistent state rewards
copying the starting point, so gains must be measured against baselines with the same history; NeuroWorld’s only
linear baseline is stimulus-only and its identification metric leaves the candidate pool unspecified, choices we show
inflate gains ( Secs. 5 and 6.5 ). EEG foundation models [ 24 , 47 , 10 ] and fMRI foundation models [ 48 ] are evaluated mostly on classification, not forecasting,
and EEG representations align with video and language models only modestly above a time-shifted
control [ 46 ] . EEG-World follows from these
properties. It infers a latent state from seconds of EEG, forecasts band power, adds the video as a zero-initialized
action to dynamics pretrained on continuous EEG, and reads out through shared and subject-specific linear heads.

training, 391 validation and 394 test clips, which an ancillary file lists by public clip identifier, and every
preprocessing, model and evaluation setting are public or fully specified.

blocks.en:
Our benchmark has five tasks, namely multi-step
forecasting, use of the video through clip swapping and clip-locked r r , clip identification, transfer to unseen
subjects and data scaling, and fixes three choices that decide the conclusions.

主题和数据缩放,并修正决定结论的三种选择。

blocks.en:
Every task reports the context mean, history-only ridge and history + video ridge, each per subject, pooled and
hierarchical; linear models are hard to beat on brain data [ 42 , 20 ] and time
series [ 51 ] . A stimulus-only linear model, the usual encoding baseline [ 9 , 13 ] ,
reaches a per-step correlation of only 0.04 on our trials, against 0.23 once EEG history is added; comparing with it
would overstate any forecaster’s gain several-fold. On trials, hierarchical ridge beats per-subject
ridge by 0.008 skill, so comparing with per-subject ridge alone would double the apparent gain of the world model.

分级; 线性模型在大脑数据 [42, 20] 和时间上很难被击败
系列 [51]. 唯一刺激线性模型,常用编码基线[9,13],

将会夸大任何预测者数倍的收益。 在审判中,等级山脊按主体排列
脊比0.008技能,因此仅与每个主体的脊比,就能使世界模型的明显收益翻一番.

blocks.en:
The headline metric is the forecast correlation r r , as in brain encoding [ 9 , 13 ] .
It is the Pearson r r across test windows for each forecast step and each feature, averaged over features and steps. Because r r ignores amplitude, we also report skill , the squared error relative to the context-mean forecast x ¯ ctx \bar{x}^{\,\mathrm{ctx}} , skill = 1 − ∑ t = T c + 1 T ∑ d = 1 D ( x ^ t , d − x t , d ) 2 ∑ t = T c + 1 T ∑ d = 1 D ( x ¯ d ctx − x t , d ) 2 , \mathrm{skill}=1-\frac{\sum_{t=T_{c}+1}^{T}\sum_{d=1}^{D}(\hat{x}_{t,d}-x_{t,d})^{2}}{\sum_{t=T_{c}+1}^{T}\sum_{d=1}^{D}(\bar{x}^{\,\mathrm{ctx}}_{d}-x_{t,d})^{2}}, (3) which rewards calibrated amplitude. Pre-registered decisions used skill; every comparison that is significant under
either metric points the same way under both, except zero-shot transfer ( Sec. 6.3 ). To make
differences tangible we also express them in time. The horizon gained is how many seconds earlier the baseline’s
per-step r r falls to the level the model reaches at the last step (linear interpolation between steps, per
subject).
Trial results are averaged within each test clip and then across clips, so frequently shown clips do not dominate.

To ask whether a forecast knows what is being watched, we hold the real context fixed and forecast once for
each test clip; the true clip should give the forecast closest to the recorded EEG. A model
that ignores the video scores exactly chance. We also report results under the evaluation
protocol of comparable work [ 9 ] ( Sec. 6.5 ).

blocks.en: 6.1 Forecasting continuous EEG
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 预测连续的 EEG

blocks.en:
As in scaling studies [ 25 , 21 ] , we pretrain EEG-World without video on nested
pools of continuous EEG and compare it at every size with the best linear history model fitted on the same data
( Fig. 4 ). The ranking reverses with scale. With tens of hours the linear model is clearly better; the world
model overtakes it between 227 and 685 pooled hours and from then on wins in every subject. The nonlinear part of EEG
dynamics thus becomes learnable only once hundreds of hours are pooled across people, which explains why linear
forecasters are hard to beat on typical EEG datasets of a few hours per person.
blocks.zh:
就像在规模研究[25,21], 我们预训EEG-World 没有视频在巢中
连续EEG集合,并按大小与同一数据中的最佳线性历史模型进行比较
(图4). 排名随规模反转. 数以十计的线性模型显然更好;
模型超过227至685个集合小时,从那时起在每个学科中获胜。 EEG的非线性部分
因此,只有在数百小时的集合下,才能学习动态,这就是为什么线性
预测器很难在每人几小时的典型的EEG数据集上击败.

blocks.en:
Beyond the crossover the two models diverge. The best linear model levels off after a few hundred hours, so more data
add nothing that a linear map from the recent past can use, while the world model keeps improving up to 2,012 h.
About half of this late improvement comes from the larger training budget and half from the additional data ( Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
除了交叉外 两个模型是不同的。 几百小时后最好的线性模型水平,所以更多的数据
添加近期的线性地图无法使用的任何内容,而世界模型则不断改进至2,012 h.
较晚改进的大约一半来自较大的培训预算,一半来自补充数据(附录F)。

blocks.en:
The same architecture with every nonlinearity removed falls below closed-form ridge, so the gain is not an artifact of
training. An MLP and an iTransformer [ 31 ] that map the
same context directly to the future, with the same heads and budget, barely improve on the linear model, so
nonlinearity alone is not enough. LSTM and
causal-Transformer cores, which like the GRU unroll a latent sequence step by step, gain almost as much as the GRU
( Fig. 4 , right). What the linear models miss is therefore how the brain’s state evolves, not a richer map
from past to future. The GRU is both the best and the smallest core, so at this scale a compact recurrent state matters
more than capacity.
blocks.zh:
与除去的所有非线性建筑一样的建筑 都落在封闭式山脊之下 所以收益不是一件艺术品
培训。 MLP和iTransformer [31] 绘制
同样的背景直接到未来, 同样的头和预算, 几乎没有改善线性模型,所以
单靠非线性是不够的。 LSTM和
因果-转录核像GRU一样,一步一步地解开潜伏的序列,得到的几乎与GRU一样多.
(图4,右). 因此,线性模型错失的是大脑状态如何演变,而不是更丰富的地图
从过去到未来。 GRU既是最好的,也是最小的核心,所以在这个规模上,一个紧凑的反复出现的国家事务
不仅仅是能力。

On held-out clips EEG-World improves on the strongest history + video encoding model by 12% in r r ( Tab. 2 ). The advantage is small in the first second and grows with the horizon. To be as accurate at its
last step as EEG-World, the linear model would have to stop 3.3 s earlier. The first second after the context is
largely fixed by the immediate past, which any forecaster can copy; the world model’s value lies in carrying the state
further ahead. Stateless nonlinear forecasters help more on trials than on continuous EEG but stay well below
EEG-World, so the recurrent state matters with video as it does without.

继续前进。 无国籍的非线性预测器在审判方面比在连续的EEG方面帮助更多,但远远低于
EEG-World,所以反复出现的状态与视频一样重要,因为它没有。

blocks.en:
More video-paired data help the world model more than the linear model, and its clip-locked response grows with them
( Fig. 5 ). Yet the linear encoding model follows the mean response across viewers more closely
( Fig. 5 b), while the world model forecasts each viewer more accurately ( Fig. 5 a). The two targets
differ, because averaging over viewers removes the state-dependent part of the signal that the world model predicts. A
benchmark that scores models only against averaged responses therefore favors encoding models and cannot see what a
forecaster of individual brains adds.

We tested 24 subjects never used during development, once, with the analysis fixed in advance; both the subjects and

beats the best history + video linear model in 23 of the 24 ( Fig. 6 a); a model retrained on the other 41
subjects replicates the result ( Fig. 6 b).

A world model that never saw video transfers almost as well as the video model, although the video model does use the
clip ( Fig. 6 c). What carries over to a new brain is mainly the dynamics learned from continuous EEG; the
stimulus mapping learned on the training cohort adds little for someone new. Averaging world-model and linear
forecasts beats both, so the two make partly independent errors. On two other EEG devices a frozen model with only a
new head merely matches the linear models ( Appendix I ), so the dynamics transfer across people within a recording setup
but not yet across devices.

blocks.en:
It is positive at every electrode and band, on continuous EEG and on video trials ( Fig. 7 a). A model that had learned a local response, such as occipital α \alpha to visual
input, would give a localized map; a gain spread over the whole scalp points to a global brain state. On video trials
it is largest in α \alpha ( + 20 % +20\% ), the rhythm most closely tied to visual attention and arousal, and about three times as large
as on continuous EEG.

A linear forecaster can only let each feature relax toward its mean at a fixed rate. If the brain’s return depends on
where it starts, a nonlinear model should gain most when the starting state is unusual. Indeed, the gain grows
steadily with the distance of the starting state from the subject’s mean, and the farthest fifth of starting states
gains 1.6 × 1.6\times as much as the nearest in r r ( + 5.2 % +5.2\% against + 3.2 % +3.2\% ; Fig. 7 b) and 3.8 × 3.8\times as
much in skill. The advantage is concentrated where linear relaxation
is least adequate, in states far from equilibrium. The forecasts are smooth but not shrunk toward the mean ( Appendix G ).

and record the change in the forecast. On held-out validation clips we measure the same tuning in recorded EEG from the

strongest feature, the first CLIP component, which separates plucked-string instruments from vehicles, the θ \theta -band maps nearly coincide. The model was trained only to forecast single viewings and never saw an averaged
response, so this agreement is not built in. Forecasting individual viewers forces the video pathway to learn the
stimulus–response relations that population averages reveal.

Because the clip enters EEG-World only through its features, swapping the encoder turns the model into a test of
vision models ( Tab. 3 ). The forecast correlation hardly changes across encoders, since it is dominated by
the brain’s own dynamics; the clip-locked response, which isolates the clip-driven part of the forecast, separates them
clearly. V-JEPA 2 [ 3 ] , trained to predict masked parts of videos in its latent space, drives this
response best, 35% above our CLIP + DINOv2 input. Temporal input alone does not explain this, because VideoMAE, also a
video model but trained to reconstruct pixels, ranks with the image models. The objective of predicting video in a latent
space thus appears to matter more than seeing motion. The main results keep the pre-registered CLIP + DINOv2 input.

blocks.en: 6.5 Stimulus identification
blocks.zh: 6.5 刺激识别

blocks.en:
Under NeuroWorld’s trajectory-matching protocol [ 9 ] , EEG-World finds the right trial among the
subject’s test viewings far above chance and slightly more often than the linear model. But a “model” that ignores
the video and repeats the context mean already reaches 12.5 × 12.5\times chance, and widening the candidate pool to all
viewings moves the same forecasts from 16 × 16\times to 145 × 145\times chance. The protocol mainly measures how persistent
the starting state is and how the pool is drawn. Under our persistence-controlled protocol, where ignoring the video
scores exactly chance, both EEG-World and the linear model identify the clip above chance but are not separated, because a
single viewing carries little clip-specific information in band power. This information adds up across viewers
( Fig. 8 ). Averaging each candidate’s score over all viewings of a test clip, each forecast from its own
context, raises top-1 identification from 0.8% to 3.8% of the 394 clips (chance 0.25%; linear model 3.3%), and
the top candidate shares the true clip’s category in 13% of clips (chance 4%). This pooled analysis is post hoc.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
In every analysis the strongest predictor of the next seconds of EEG was the brain’s own state, and what transferred
to unseen subjects was the dynamics learned from continuous EEG. A brain-based benchmark for vision that ignores these
dynamics attributes to the stimulus what belongs to the brain; history-aware baselines and persistence-controlled
metrics are cheap and should be standard. Because the advantage grows with training EEG, forecasting is a natural
pretraining objective for EEG foundation models.
blocks.zh:
在每一次分析中, 脑电图接下来几秒钟的最强预测器 是大脑自身的状态,
从连续的 EEG 学到的动力学是不可见的。 基于大脑的愿景基准忽视了这些
属于大脑的刺激的动态属性;历史认知基线和持久性控制
衡量标准是廉价的,应该标准。 因为随着EEG的训练 优势会增长 预测是自然的
EEG基础模型的预培训目标。

blocks.en:
We forecast one representation (per-second log band power); finer time scales and source-space targets remain open.
Video helped the trained cohort but added no net gain on unseen subjects. The core subjects’ test sets were used in
several pre-registered analyses, all listed in Appendix K ; the confirmatory transfer result uses 24 subjects tested
once. Clips were shown in a largely fixed order, so carry-over from the previous clip is controlled only through the
swap analyses.

我们预测一种表示(每秒对数波段功率);更细的时间尺度和源空间目标仍然开放。
视频帮助了训练有素的人群,但并没有为看不见的课题增加净收益。 核心主体测试集用于

曾经 剪辑以大致固定的顺序显示,因此以往剪辑的结转只能通过
交换分析。

The cap samples at 250 Hz with the reference at FCz; the corpus preprocessing

its first clip onset. For every bin and channel, the power spectrum is a multitaper estimate with discrete prolate
spheroidal tapers of time–half-bandwidth product 2, keeping tapers with spectral concentration above 0.9, after
removing the mean and weighting the tapers by their eigenvalues. Band power is the mean spectral power over the
frequency bins of δ \delta 1–4, θ \theta 4–8, α \alpha 8–13, β \beta 13–30 and γ \gamma 30–45 Hz, and the
feature is its base-10 logarithm, giving 31 × 5 = 155 31\times 5=155 features per second. A bin is marked bad when any channel’s
peak-to-peak amplitude exceeds 500 μ \mu V; features are z-scored per recording over its good bins, and windows that
contain a bad bin are skipped.

blocks.en:
Two conclusions follow. A large part of each viewer’s response is carried over from before the clip, which is why our
baselines see the same EEG history rather than the stimulus alone. And carrying a state forward does not by itself
separate the world model from the linear model, since any history-aware forecaster does it; the world model’s
advantage lies in how the state evolves, most of all when it starts far from the subject’s usual state ( Fig. 7 b).

以下两个结论。 每个观众的回答大部分都是从剪辑前传过来的 这就是为什么我们
基线是相同的EEG历史,而不仅仅是刺激。 推进国家不是靠自己

优势在于状态是如何演变的,最关键的是在远离主体通常状态时(图7b).

Tables S5 and S6 list every pre-registered test run on the data of this paper, H1 to H60, including those the main text does not discuss. Before each round we wrote down its hypotheses,
models, selection procedure, decision rules and the test data it would score, and scored the test data only
afterwards. Unless noted, a test is decided on skill by the rule of Sec. 5 ; for H12–H14 the subject
criterion was more than half of the 24 (the outcomes are the same under 16/24), and on the lab cap it was 9/12.
Non-inferiority tests require the lower bound of the 95% interval above the stated margin, and second attempts after
a failed test use p < 0.025 p<0.025 . The identifiers H7, H39 and H40 were never registered. The core subjects’ test data were
scored in many rounds, so later results on them are not independent replications; the 24 unseen subjects were first
scored in the confirmatory test (H12–H14) and later in H24–H26, H53 and H53b. Before this corpus existed, pilot
models trained only on the lab-cap data and on the EEG Moments Dataset [ 14 ] , a few hours per
subject, did not beat linear forecasters; H41–H45 repeat the lab-cap comparison with the pretrained model.

blocks.en:
Of the 60 tests, 36 were met and 23 failed; H35 was two-sided. Several failures shaped the paper. The first video
model, trained from scratch, lost to the linear model (H4); pretraining on continuous EEG helped (H9) but needed a
second attempt to beat the best linear model (H8, H11). The linear model’s video term matched the mean response
across viewers better than the world model’s (H18, H20), although the world model’s clip-locked response grew with
more data (H19). On unseen subjects’ continuous EEG the frozen model beat the best linear model only nominally (H12),
zero-shot transfer lost (H24, H25), and multi-device pretraining transferred slightly worse to new people (H53,
H53b), so the main models are trained on one device. Fine-tuning the video pathway on the 2,012-h core with the
908-h recipe was worse (H32, H33), as early stopping ended 7 of 8 runs at epoch 8 before the video pathway
converged. On the lab cap, pretraining turned the pilots’ loss into parity but not into a win (H41–H45).
Identification did not separate EEG-World from the linear model (H23, H34; Appendix H ), neither the visual nor
the audio gain was specific to the matching sensory electrodes (H49, H50; Appendix E ), and the calibration
criterion failed on video trials (H60; Appendix G ).

模型从零开始训练,输给线性模型(H4); 连续的EEG预训帮助(H9),但需要一个
第二次尝试击败最佳线性模型(H8,H11). 线性模型的视频术语符合平均响应

更多的数据(H19)。 在未见对象的连续EEG上,冷冻模型仅名义上(H12)击败了最好的线性模型,

H53b),因此主要型号都训练在一个装置上. 微调2 012(h)核心的视频路径
